attempts.text: [{"name": "longterm_profile_cooc", "idea": "Cosine co-occurrence over the last 180 steps summed over the user's older items (positions 21 to 60 by recency), capturing long-term taste that the last-20 cooc source ignores.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH e AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 180), lu AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) x WHERE rn > 20 AND rn <= 60), src AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM lu), ni AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM e GROUP BY item_id), co AS (SELECT a.item_id AS i, b.item_id AS j, COUNT(*) AS c FROM e a JOIN e b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.item_id <> b.item_id WHERE a.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM src) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, SUM(co.c / sqrt(n1.c * n2.c)) AS ag_lt_cooc FROM cand c JOIN lu ON lu.user_id = c.user_id JOIN co ON co.i = lu.item_id AND co.j = c.item_id JOIN ni n1 ON n1.item_id = co.i JOIN ni n2 ON n2.item_id = co.j GROUP BY 1, 2;"}, {"name": "iuf_weighted_cooc", "idea": "Item-item cosine over the last 90 steps where each co-occurring user is down-weighted by 1/ln(2 + activity), so heavy users do not dominate similarity, summed over the user's last 10 items.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH e AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 90), du AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS d FROM e GROUP BY user_id), ew AS (SELECT e.user_id, e.item_id, 1.0 / LN(2 + du.d) AS w FROM e JOIN du ON du.user_id = e.user_id), lu AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) x WHERE rn <= 10), src AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM lu), ni AS (SELECT item_id, SUM(w) AS c FROM ew GROUP BY item_id), co AS (SELECT a.item_id AS i, b.item_id AS j, SUM(a.w) AS c FROM ew a JOIN ew b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.item_id <> b.item_id WHERE a.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM src) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, SUM(co.c / sqrt(n1.c * n2.c)) AS ag_iuf_cooc FROM cand c JOIN lu ON lu.user_id = c.user_id JOIN co ON co.i = lu.item_id AND co.j = c.item_id JOIN ni n1 ON n1.item_id = co.i JOIN ni n2 ON n2.item_id = co.j GROUP BY 1, 2;"}, {"name": "user_visit_rhythm", "idea": "Visit frequency rather than item volume: the number of distinct active steps in the last 30 steps and the mean gap between distinct active steps over the last 90 steps.", "level": "user", "sql": "WITH s AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, t FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users) AND t >= {A} - 90) SELECT user_id, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t >= {A} - 30 THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_steps_30, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN CAST(MAX(t) - MIN(t) AS DOUBLE) / (COUNT(*) - 1) END AS ag_gap_90 FROM s GROUP BY user_id;"}, {"name": "item_burstiness30", "idea": "Coefficient of variation of the item's per-step event counts over the last 30 steps, separating steady demand from one-off bursts that are less likely to persist into the label window.", "level": "item", "sql": "WITH s AS (SELECT item_id, t, COUNT(*) AS c FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30 GROUP BY item_id, t) SELECT item_id, SQRT(GREATEST(CAST(SUM(c * c) AS DOUBLE) / 30.0 - POWER(CAST(SUM(c) AS DOUBLE) / 30.0, 2), 0)) / (CAST(SUM(c) AS DOUBLE) / 30.0) AS ag_burst30 FROM s GROUP BY item_id;"}, {"name": "neighbor_recent7_adoption", "idea": "Fresh co-adoption: among users who took one of u's last 5 items in the last 90 steps, the share who took candidate j in the last 7 steps, summed over those items, so the signal tracks what similar users are adopting right now.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH e AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 90), r7 AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 7), lu AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) x WHERE rn <= 5), src AS (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM lu), ni AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM e WHERE item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM src) GROUP BY item_id), co AS (SELECT a.item_id AS i, b.item_id AS j, COUNT(*) AS c FROM e a JOIN r7 b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.item_id <> b.item_id WHERE a.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM src) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, SUM(CAST(co.c AS DOUBLE) / ni.c) AS ag_nbr_recent7 FROM cand c JOIN lu ON lu.user_id = c.user_id JOIN co ON co.i = lu.item_id AND co.j = c.item_id JOIN ni ON ni.item_id = co.i GROUP BY 1, 2;"}]
